According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity, and sow trouble, reap the same.
He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

translations.web: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
translations.bsb: You have plowed wickedness and reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your own way and in the multitude of your mighty men,
translations.kjv: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
translations.asv: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies; for thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
